description: Na₆TiMn(SiO₃)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R3m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.86 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.91 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There are three shorter (1.91 Å) and three longer (2.06 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. Mn is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.14 Å) and three longer (2.55 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 30°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 40°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, one Mn, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one Si atom.
